description: Header file defining capabilities, extensions, and related structures for OpenGL and EGL in the ANGLE project, including classes for texture capabilities, extension support, and hardware limitations.

classes.name: TextureCaps
classes.description: Represents capabilities of a specific texture format, including support for texturing, filtering, framebuffer attachment, and sample counts.

classes.name: TextureCapsMap
classes.description: Manages a collection of TextureCaps objects indexed by format or format ID.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: Encapsulates supported OpenGL extension support flags and provides methods to query extension strings.

classes.name: Limitations
classes.description: Describes hardware or renderer limitations affecting shader and rendering capabilities.

classes.name: Caps
classes.description: Stores various hardware and implementation-dependent limits for OpenGL and EGL.

classes.name: egl::Caps
classes.description: EGL-specific capabilities, including support for NPOT surfaces.

classes.name: egl::DisplayExtensions
classes.description: Supported extensions for EGL display, indicating available features and extensions.

methods.name: GenerateMinimumTextureCaps
methods.description: Generates minimal texture capabilities based on format, version, and extensions.

methods.name: GenerateMinimumCaps
methods.description: Generates minimal overall capabilities based on client version and extensions.
